title: Pet Mood Diary Studio
oneLiner: A playful pet journaling app that turns daily behavior notes into a shareable mood card and story recap.
targetUser: Pet owners, casual journalers, and social-first users who like saving cute daily moments.
keyUX: Log a few pet behaviors, generate a playful emotion summary, and export a cute story card worth saving or sharing.
stitchPrompt: Design a playful desktop-to-mobile pet journaling app called Pet Mood Diary Studio for pet owners who love saving and sharing cute daily moments. It should turn simple behavior notes and photo moments into a charming emotional summary card, a mini story recap, and a shareable visual keepsake. Include a mood hero card, a daily behavior log, an emotion interpretation panel, a story-card preview area, a sticker customization bar, and a share action panel. Design direction: use a bold playful-product aesthetic with soft lilac, cream, sky blue, and juicy coral accents; keep the UI highly shareable, characterful, and visually delightful without becoming childish clutter.
